setup.title: Set up the database
setup.intro: Deixa keeps catalog, subtitles and progress in a PostgreSQL database on your computer or on another server of yours.
setup.dbUnreachable: The configured database did not answer.
setup.fromEnvironment: This server’s connection comes from the DATABASE_URL variable. Fix the value there and restart Deixa.
setup.codeNote: To make sure it is you, open the file {file} in the folder where Deixa is installed and type the 12-character code in it.
setup.embeddedOption: Install a Postgres just for Deixa
setup.embeddedOptionBody: Recommended. The app downloads Postgres once (about 30 MB), keeps everything in its own folder and starts it along. Nothing to configure.
setup.existingOptionBody: On this computer, on the home network or in the cloud. You enter address, user and password.
setup.installing: Installing a Postgres just for Deixa.
setup.installingBody: It lives in the app data folder and starts along with it. About 30 MB download; first time only.

phase.starting: Starting Postgres and preparing the tables…

setup.notFound: No Postgres found on this computer.

guide.macos: We recommend installing Postgres.app (postgresapp.com). Download, drag to Applications, open and click Initialize. The user is your Mac username, with no password.
guide.windows: We recommend the official installer (postgresql.org/download/windows). During installation, note the password you set for the postgres user.
guide.linux: We recommend your distribution’s package (for example, sudo apt install postgresql). Then create a user with a password: sudo -u postgres createuser --pwprompt --createdb deixa.

setup.storedLocallyNote: If the database does not exist yet, Deixa creates it. The address is stored only on this computer, in a file only your user can read.

notices.untestedVersion: Connected to Postgres {version}. Deixa was tested from {tested} on; if something fails, update Postgres.

messages.alreadyReady: The database is already configured. Sign in normally.
messages.wrongCode: Wrong code. Check the file on the computer where Deixa runs.
messages.invalidFields: Check the fields. The database name accepts only lowercase letters, digits and underscore.

reasons.connectionRefused: No Postgres is answering at that address and port.
reasons.hostNotFound: We could not find that server. Check the address.
reasons.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Check the address and port.
reasons.authFailed: User or password rejected by Postgres.
reasons.notAuthorized: Postgres did not authorize this user. Check user, password and the server access rules.
reasons.databaseMissing: That database does not exist and could not be created. Create it or enter another one.
reasons.noPermission: This user is not allowed to create the database or the tables. Use a user with permission.
reasons.noConnections: Postgres has no free connections. Try again in a moment.
reasons.invalidUrl: Invalid address. Use postgres://user:password@server:port/database, with a lowercase database name.
reasons.fromEnvironment: The connection comes from this server’s DATABASE_URL variable. Adjust the value there and restart.
reasons.generic: Could not connect. Check the fields and try again.

conversationReview.confirm: Create {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} and add to series
conversationReview.confirmedToast: {cards, plural, =0 { No cards created} one {# card created} other {# cards created}}{episodes, plural, =0 {} one { · # new episode} other { · # new episodes}}

series.onlyYou: Made from your conversations with the tutor. Only you can see it.
series.aboutTitle: About this series · written by the AI
series.aboutEmpty: The AI writes the description after the first review with cards, and it changes as you study.
series.aboutUpdated: Updated on {date} from {conversations, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} and {cards, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}.
series.seasonEmpty: Still empty. The AI opens this season's episodes as your conversations call for them.
series.locked: Opens once you pass {unlockAt}% of level {level}. Today: {percent}%.
series.upcomingThemes: Themes likely to come back, more advanced
series.upcomingNote: Each season is a level. These themes come back in {level} with a more advanced focus, picked from what shows up most in your conversations.
series.aiCreates: The AI creates the next episode when a new theme comes up
series.episodeMeta: {cards, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} · {sources, plural, =0 { no conversation} one {# conversation} other {# conversations}}
series.nameLabel: What do you want to call it
series.nameNote: The series id ({id}) never changes: cards, progress and the .deixa.zip package stay tied to it.
series.levelBody: Sets the level of new episodes. Each season is a CEFR level.
series.autoNote: The series follows your level ({level}) and opens the next season when you're close to moving up.
series.customNote: Seasons stay within the range: the series follows your level without leaving it.
series.emptyTrail: This episode has no cards yet.

budget.title: AI budget
budget.adminLimitNote: You use the server key. This limit belongs to the administrator and you cannot go above it.
budget.adminNoLimitNote: You use the server key and the administrator has not set a limit.
budget.capNote: A cap of your own, below the administrator limit. The lower of the two always applies.
budget.ownNote: Applies to usage with your key. Blank means no limit.
budget.ownNoKeyNote: Applies once you add a key of your own. Blank means no limit.

personAi.model: Text model on the server key
personAi.modelNote: Applies when {name} uses the server key and overrides the person's choice. With their own key, the person's choice applies.
personAi.sharedLimitNote: Applies only to {name}, instead of the default limit. The person can set a lower cap, never a higher one.
personAi.ownLimitNote: Applies when {name} uses their own key. The person can change this limit too.
